# La Tonya Jackson In The Hair Palace

> Hair salon specializing in ethnic hair based in Austin, Texas. La Tonya Jackson’s East Austin salon on Smith Rd: silk presses, relaxers, color, sew-ins, micro-links, short cuts and kids’ styles, done one client at a time.

- Phone: (512) 963-8276
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Manor, Pflugerville, Del Valle, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.3 from 44 reviews

## Services
- Cuts, short styles & finger waves: Sculpted short cuts, finger waves, swoops and spiked styles, plus clean fades and mohawks for the guys.
- Color: Burgundy, copper, platinum, honey blonde and bold fashion shades, plus color to blend extensions.
- Relaxers, silk press & updos: Relaxed or natural, hair that comes out straight, shiny and healthy, plus updos for weddings and big days.
- Sew-ins & micro-links: Full and partial sew-ins, micro-link and clip-in extensions, colored and cut to blend with your own hair.
- Twists, locs & kids: Neat two-strand twists, loc wash and retwist (toddlers too), and patient cuts and styles for kids and teens.
- Waxing: Lip, chin, underarm, leg, back, chest and bikini waxing, quick and private.

## About
The Hair Palace is La Tonya Jackson’s salon at 1500 Smith Rd in East Austin, in the strip center with the royal-blue roof. The sign out front says it plainly: specializing in ethnic hair. And it carries her motto: if your hair is not becoming to you, then you should be coming to the Palace. La Tonya has more than 20 years in the industry and is a licensed cosmetology instructor. She works on one client at a time, so your appointment is yours. Clients say she listens, asks exactly how you want it, keeps your hair healthy and won’t sell you products you don’t need. Many have followed her for years, and mothers trust her with their daughters’ hair.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday 12 to 3 p.m., Thursday and Friday 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Saturday 7 a.m. to noon. Closed Sunday and Monday. Call about Wednesdays.
- Q: Where is the Hair Palace?
  A: 1500 Smith Rd, Suite 206, Austin, TX 78721: the strip center with the royal-blue roof on Smith Rd in East Austin, next door to Austin Motor Sport. There’s easy parking in the lot out front.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Appointments only. Call (512) 963-8276. La Tonya has fit clients in at the last minute when her book allows, so it’s always worth a call.
- Q: Do you do kids’ hair?
  A: Yes. Kids’ and teens’ cuts and styles, and loc wash and retwist for little ones too. Moms are welcome to stay.
- Q: Do you do extensions?
  A: Yes: full and partial sew-ins, micro-links and clip-ins, plus coloring and removal.
- Q: Do you take cards?
  A: Yes, credit cards are accepted.
- Q: Do you do waxing?
  A: Yes: lip, chin, underarm, legs, back, chest and bikini. Prices are on the Services page.
